# Self-created glTF fixtures

These tiny fixtures were generated specifically for Sekai64 tests and are covered by the repository MIT license.

- `embedded-base-color.glb` contains a PNG in a GLB bufferView.
- `external/model.gltf` references `mesh.bin` and `base-color.png`.
- `asymmetric-base-color.png` uses distinct corners so vertical UV flipping is visible.
